title: Eastern Bean Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful bean bowl with eastern spices, perfect for a quick and easy meal.

ingredients.name: garlicky middle eastern spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern markets

ingredients.name: bean bowl toppings (optional)
ingredients.notes: such as diced tomatoes, cucumber, feta cheese, and olives

instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlicky middle eastern spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the yellow split peas and chicken broth, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the peas are tender, about 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the pea mixture over the middle eastern flatbread, if using.
Top with your desired bean bowl toppings, if using.
